learning.title: Learning (spaced repetition)
learning.description: Review cards follow the memory curve (FSRS): a small daily batch on the kid's side, rescheduled instantly on each answer. Tune each kid's intensity here.
learning.retentionHelp: Higher means more frequent reviews; 0.90 is the recommended value (Anki's official default). 0.95 adds roughly 1.6× the daily load.
learning.limitHelp: New cards amplify ~10× into future reviews; keep it ≤20 (Anki's default).
learning.errorbookDesc: Photograph a paper and the AI segments and grades it; failed parses go to "manual review" and keep the original photo. Wrong questions land in the kid's error book and corrected ones flow into review.
learning.errorbookPopover: ? What happens when it's off: existing errors and review cards stay browsable, but newly photographed papers are no longer segmented or graded and no longer enter the error book; the kid-side error book entry hides too.
learning.fsrsDesc: Review cards follow the memory curve; the kid gets a small daily batch, re-scheduled the moment they answer.
learning.profileDesc: Aggregates errors, courses and review data into a profile; every AI suggestion cites its basis (source_refs) and takes effect only after the parent approves. No chat logs are used.
